prize.text: Active purses: Quantum Applications $5M, Water Scarcity $119M, Healthspan $101M; Wildfire in finals at $11M. Prize purses are the whole programme, not a single cash prize, and payment depends on hitting milestone targets over years.
prize.quote: $5 Million Active XPRIZE Quantum Applications ... $119 Million Active XPRIZE Water Scarcity ... $101 Million Active XPRIZE Healthspan ... $11 Million Finals XPRIZE Wildfire

summary: Real mega-purses, but these are multi-year team programmes (registration, milestones, site visits), not a weekend competition; the listing states no entry fee and no eligibility on its face.
flags: Free entry is not stated on the competitions listing - left blank as unverified.
Time-to-prize is measured in years and requires an institutional team, so it is not an immediate opportunity.
